changelog:
- Multi-Page SMM Support: Facebook Pages managed by your accounts now automatically multiply order capacity and execute background actions seamlessly without stalling.
- Fast Background Post Sharing: Post sharing and combo tasks now run instantly in the background via REST API without launching browser popups or opening emulator screens.
- Facebook Pages Session Backup & Restore: Added right-click 'Backup Pages' tool to safely capture and restore full Facebook page session data.
- Automatic Link Normalization: Automatically cleans desktop links (e.g. web.facebook.com) to standard format to prevent external app chooser popups during automation.
- OpenVPN Performance Optimization: Streamlined OpenVPN connection handling and removed legacy Proton VPN overrides for faster, cleaner IP switching.
